ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) with a calculated macro-ratio of approximately 70% white to 30% black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white region occupying the lower 2/3 of the fluke. High-contrast black pigment clusters at the peduncle attachment and median notch. Parallel vertical black bands (rake marks) concentrated along the upper trailing edge margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth extends approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; left trailing edge displays low-frequency micro-serrations, while the right trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys (notches) isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a long, slender convex sweep toward the distal tip; right lobe presents a truncated, irregular convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small (approx. 5-10 pixel diameter) dark, circular clusters detected on the lower white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 5-8 parallel, high-contrast linear pigment disruptions extending from the trailing edge into the ventral surface on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular indentations and missing pixel segments along the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting major structural trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical 'combed' pigmentation pattern along the top boundary of the white ventral field.
